TenterdenPrimary Federation
Together, we learn, grow and flourish
We are very proud of our two schools who work together in a strong partnership, known as the Tenterden Primary Federation.
Tenterden Infant School
Tenterden Church of England Junior School
Welcome to
Tenterden Primary Federation
Tenterden Primary Federation is the federated partnership of Tenterden Infant School and Tenterden Church of England Junior School.
At Tenterden Primary Federation, we believe every child deserves a nurturing environment where curiosity is celebrated, talents are discovered, and confidence blossoms. From the moment your child joins us in EYFS to their proud final steps in Year 6, we are here to inspire, support, and guide them every step of the way.

Tenterden Federation - Vision Statement for PE
Our vision is for all children to experience and enjoy high quality physical education and sport. To be motivated to further develop and extend their individual potential. We aim to promote teamwork, sportsmanship and a healthy lifestyle.
‘Never rest until you have done your best!’
